correctness.rationale: For any connected symmetric Metzler zero-row-sum generators, the rank-one implicit K/L solves are irreducible positive resolvents and the scalar S step has strictly positive numerator and denominator, proving strict positivity at all steps. For rank two, the exact Galerkin K/L/S basis-invariant equations reduce to rational linear systems of orders 6,6,4 on the displayed 3x3 example; verify.py replays each exact solve, proves -9/100<output[3,3]<-8/100, and confirms the full backward Euler output is positive. No finite experiments are used in place of the universal analytic proof.

value.rationale: For nonnegative diffusing densities, unconditional positivity is a substantive structure-preservation requirement. The proof identifies the exact rank frontier of the universal positivity guarantee (rank one safe, already rank two unsafe), despite each constituent solve and the full backward Euler method being positive and energy stable. The finite witness is integral to a class-wide dichotomy, not an arbitrary numerical table or a generic negative-component check. No external certification or higher-rank classification claimed.
